color.note: Spark Blue is the default preset, Codex and Emerald are two of the shipped alternates, and High Contrast is the Increase Contrast preset. Every surface is derived from three values per mode (background, foreground, accent) with the app's own blend math, so every custom theme gets the same ladder.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Window canvas and the transcript. The theme background itself (`.appPage`, `ResolvedAppTheme.background`). Spark Blue dark is #090D16, a blue-cast night sky, never neutral gray.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Navigation rail, the 52px icon column at the leading edge. Page stepped 3% toward white (dark) or 2% toward black (light). Drawn at 90% opacity while the sidebar is translucent, solid under Reduce Transparency.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar panel beside the rail. Page stepped 5% (dark) or 3.5% (light). Drawn at 94% opacity while translucent, solid under Reduce Transparency.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Top bar and bottom status strip. One step off the page so a band reads as a strip, not a continuation of the canvas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, search fields, editors, and grouped panels (`.appSurface`). Page blended 5.5% (dark) or 2.5% (light) toward ink.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, and anything raised above a card (`.appElevated`). Page blended 9% (dark) or 5% (light) toward ink.

tokens.name: composer
tokens.usage: The prompt composer fill (`ResolvedAppTheme.composerBackground`), and the Humanize and script editor composers. The most raised surface in the window.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The Spark Blue night sky, constant in every theme. Brand ground for the cover, marketing art, and the dock icon only. Never a UI surface (use `page`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface above (`.appText`). 13.3:1 or better on all of them in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary rows, subtitles, metadata, placeholder text (`.appSecondary`). Ink at 75%, 90% above contrast 70, 96% under Increase Contrast. Lowest pair: 8.1:1 in the dark themes, 7.0:1 in the light ones, on composer.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and chips only (AppChip uses 0.45). Exempt from contrast minimums, so never use it for text a person must read. A disabled control says why in its tooltip.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card, field, and editor strokes (`.appBorder`), 1px. Ink at 0.12 + contrast/500. Decorative separation only: 1.5:1 to 2.2:1 across the preset themes, below the 3:1 control-boundary floor. Rises to 75% under Increase Contrast.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The edge of a control that is identified by its edge alone (an empty field on a matching fill, a checkbox). Ink at 35% to 48% depending on the theme: 3:1 on every surface. Equal to `border` under Increase Contrast.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The 0.5px seams between chrome bands (rail, sidebar, top bar, status strip). A lighter line of the same palette, never a system separator color. Decorative.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action fill, selected rail icon, progress fill, focus edge, live state. Spark Blue #3B9EFF dark, #1D6FE0 light. Codex is near-black and near-white, Emerald is green. As text, Spark Blue light drops to 4.2:1 on composer, so set text in `accent-ink`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Accent used as text or a small glyph (links, selected rail symbol, "Ready"). 4.6:1 or better on every surface in every theme. Differs from `accent` only in Spark Blue light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill, from `Color.contrastForeground`: near-black #141417 on a bright accent, white on a deep one. 4.7:1 or better in every theme. White on the Spark Blue dark accent is 2.7:1: check native .borderedProminent labels against this.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind an on chip and a selected rail item (accent at 14%). Text on it stays `ink`.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline stroke around an on chip (accent at 30%, 0.5px). Decorative. The tint and `.isSelected` carry the state.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text and selected list rows (`ResolvedAppTheme.selection`). Accent at 25% dark, 12% light, 45% and 30% under Increase Contrast.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px accent ring with a 2px gap, 3px under Increase Contrast. 4.2:1 or better on every surface in every theme. The soft halo (`glow-focus`) is extra, never the only cue.

tokens.name: focus-edge
tokens.usage: The composer and editor focus edge as shipped (accent at 55%, 1.5px, solid 2.5px under Increase Contrast). Spark Blue: 2.6:1 dark and 2.1:1 light on composer, under the 3:1 focus floor. Pair it with `focus-ring` for keyboard focus, or raise it.

tokens.name: composer-edge
tokens.usage: Resting 1px stroke of the composer and focus-glow editors (ink at 18% dark, 14% light, `border` under Increase Contrast). Decorative: 1.3:1 to 1.7:1.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rail items, sidebar rows, and quiet buttons (ink at 7%). Hover never changes layout.

tokens.name: chip-fill
tokens.usage: Resting fill of an off chip (ink at 4%).

tokens.name: chip-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered off chip (ink at 8%).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Progress bar track (ink at 10%). Gains a `border` stroke under Increase Contrast.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Intentional addition, replacing system .green/.orange/.red on themed surfaces. Success: done, ready, allowed, resident. Pair with checkmark.circle.fill and a word. 4.8:1 or better on every surface and on its own tint (7:1 in the high-contrast themes). Bluish green, off the red-green axis, so it stays distinct from `danger` with color-vision deficiency.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Intentional addition, replacing system .green/.orange/.red on themed surfaces. Warning: needs attention, degraded, partial. Pair with exclamationmark.triangle.fill and a word. 4.8:1 or better on every surface and on its own tint (7:1 in the high-contrast themes).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Intentional addition, replacing system .green/.orange/.red on themed surfaces. Danger and destructive: failed, denied, delete. Pair with xmark.octagon.fill and a word. Destructive buttons also carry `role: .destructive`. 4.8:1 or better on every surface and on its own tint (7:1 in the high-contrast themes).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a success status pill or banner (success at 14%). Text on it is `success`, not ink.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a warning status pill or banner (warning at 14%). Text on it is `warning`, not ink.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a danger status pill or banner (danger at 14%). Text on it is `danger`, not ink.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: AppFontStep.display (2.25x): display numerals and hero empty-state symbols.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: AppFontStep.hero (1.875x): medium empty-state symbols.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: AppFontStep.title (1.6875x): window headings.

styles.name: title2
styles.usage: AppFontStep.title2 (1.3125x): pane headings.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: AppFontStep.title3 (1.125x): section headings, empty-state titles.

styles.name: large
styles.usage: AppFontStep.large (1.0625x): slightly emphasized body.

styles.name: base
styles.usage: AppFontStep.base: body text, transcript, field text. The default UI base is 16pt.
styles.sample: Everything here runs on your Mac. Nothing leaves it.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: AppFontStep.callout (0.875x): control labels, card and sheet titles.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: AppFontStep.small (0.75x): secondary rows, sidebar text, subtitles, chip labels (medium).

styles.name: tiny
styles.usage: AppFontStep.tiny (0.6875x): fine print, timestamps, dense metadata, chip glyphs.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: AppFontStep.micro (0.5625x): overline chips, micro badges, chart ticks. Never body copy.

styles.name: code-title3
styles.usage: themedCode(.title3): code headings. The code base is its own setting (12pt default).

styles.name: code-large
styles.usage: themedCode(.large): emphasized code.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: themedCode(.base): code blocks, terminal output, model ids, file paths, token counts, keyboard chords.

styles.name: code-callout
styles.usage: themedCode(.callout): telemetry readouts in the top bar and status strip.

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: The welcome greeting only: theme.ui(.display, weight: .regular, systemDesign: .serif). One serif line per window, never elsewhere.

styles.name: option-inter
styles.sample: Everything here runs on your Mac.
styles.usage: Inter, a bundled interface family the user can pick in Appearance. Specimen only: views never name a family, they read the theme.

styles.name: option-jetbrains
styles.usage: JetBrains Mono, a bundled code family the user can pick. Specimen only.

styles.name: option-fira
styles.usage: Fira Code, a bundled code family the user can pick. Specimen only.

styles.name: option-cascadia
styles.usage: Cascadia Code, a bundled code family the user can pick. Specimen only.

styles.name: option-hack
styles.usage: Hack, a bundled code family the user can pick. Specimen only.

styles.name: option-sourcecode
styles.usage: Source Code Pro, a bundled code family the user can pick. Specimen only.

spacing.note: Real values from the SwiftUI views, irregular on purpose: 5px stays 5px.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Title to subtitle in AppSectionHeader.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between rail items; sidebar row vertical padding; empty-state actions top offset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Chip and search field vertical padding; chip icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Search glyph to field text; rail inset below the top bar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: AppMetrics.actionSpacing: gap between header actions. Control and row horizontal padding; editor inset.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Sidebar row icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Row gap when AppAdaptiveHeader stacks actions under the title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Title-to-actions gap in a header row; empty-state stack gap.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Card padding (`.appCardSurface()` default).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

radius.note: All corners are continuous (style: .continuous) in the app.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: AppMetrics.controlRadius: text fields, search, editor surfaces, sidebar rows.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: AppChip and navigation rail items.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: AppMetrics.cardRadius: cards and grouped panels.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: AppMetrics.composerRadius: the prompt composer and composer-style surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules: progress bars, status pills, the model loader capsule.

shadow.note: Separation comes from fill steps and borders. Shadows are limited to the composer and the two accent glows.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: Resting composer lift (SwiftUI radius 6, y 2). The only drop shadow in the system. Cards separate by fill and border.

tokens.name: shadow-composer-focus
tokens.usage: Composer lift while it holds focus (SwiftUI radius 10).

tokens.name: glow-focus
tokens.usage: Accent halo outside a focused editor with no native ring (`.appFocusGlow`), cast by an edge behind the surface. None under Increase Contrast, where the ring goes solid.

tokens.name: glow-primary
tokens.usage: Halo under the one primary action while it can run (`.appPrimaryGlow`): the composer Send button. Never on a disabled or secondary action.

layout.note: Chrome bands and adaptive widths. Multiply any frame that holds text by the text scale.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Navigation rail width (AppChromeLayout.navigationRailWidth).

tokens.name: rail-item
tokens.usage: Rail item square at the default sidebar scale; grows to 42px.

tokens.name: top-bar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar: what the machine is doing (memory, CPU, GPU, share).

tokens.name: status-bar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom status strip: tokens, speed, thermals.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar panel default width.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Trailing inspector (Model Settings, Chat summary).

tokens.name: inspector-wide-width
tokens.usage: Expanded inspector.

tokens.name: content-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the working pane.

tokens.name: window-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum main window height.

tokens.name: message-max-width
tokens.usage: Max line length of an empty-state message; multiply by the text scale.

tokens.name: search-min-width
tokens.usage: AppSearchField minWidth. Never a fixed width.

tokens.name: search-ideal-width
tokens.usage: AppSearchField idealWidth.

tokens.name: search-max-width
tokens.usage: AppSearchField maxWidth.

tokens.name: status-dot
tokens.usage: Model status dot diameter.

tokens.name: progress-compact
tokens.usage: AppProgressBar compact height, in a status strip or row; times the text scale.

tokens.name: progress-regular
tokens.usage: AppProgressBar regular height, the main progress of a card; times the text scale.
